_comment: OPTIONAL. Copy to config/plan.json to seed the console's per-slot budget (bid ceilings). It's a DISCIPLINED DEFAULT to enter the draft with, not a validated-optimal allocation — no fixed budget validated out-of-sample (see analysis/research/strategy_search.py). Keys are the console's roster slots; values are $ you'd pay UP TO for that slot. The console prices each ceiling by 'will-go' so you see the tier it actually wins, and every slot stays editable live. Omit this file to fall back to a neutral worth-proportional frame. Slots must sum to your budget (bench absorbs the remainder). This example encodes 'two reliable studs + discipline': pay up for one bellcow RB + one alpha WR (the low-bust tiers), value/darts elsewhere, walk from the busty mid-tier.
